title: 腎臟內科
intro: 急慢性腎病、透析、電解質與腎絲球疾病。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Acute and chronic kidney disease, dialysis, electrolytes and glomerular disease. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=腎性高血壓與次發性高血壓

procedures.title: 肌酸酐上升：先找到基準
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：75 歲男性腹瀉後虛弱，最近使用新的止痛藥。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 75-year-old man is weak after diarrhoea and recently started an analgesic. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 肌酸酐偏高，但目前沒有舊值。
stages.evidenceEn: Creatinine is high but no previous value is available.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 找基準並追蹤尿量與趨勢
choices.en: Find baseline and follow urine and trends

choices.zh: 單次偏高就確定永久末期腎病
choices.en: One high result proves permanent end-stage disease

choices.zh: 沒有舊數字就不需任何評估
choices.en: No baseline means no assessment is needed

stages.reason: 急性變化需結合時間與其他線索。
stages.reasonEn: Acute change requires timing and other findings.
stages.pitfall: 沒有基準容易混淆急慢性。
stages.pitfallEn: Missing baseline can confuse acute and chronic disease.

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 虛擬檢驗：肌酸酐從 48 小時前的 0.9 升至 1.6 mg/dL，尿量也減少。
stages.evidenceEn: Simulated results: creatinine rises from 0.9 to 1.6 mg/dL over 48 hours, with reduced urine.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 把所有腎損傷都用相同方式處理
choices.en: Manage all kidney injuries identically

choices.zh: 評估容量、藥物與阻塞等病因
choices.en: Review volume, medicines and obstruction

choices.zh: 只認定腹瀉，不再核對藥物
choices.en: Assume diarrhoea alone without medicine review

stages.reason: 腎損傷可能有多重因素。
stages.reasonEn: Kidney injury can have several contributors.
stages.pitfall: 漏掉可逆因素會妨礙恢復。

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 基準與肌酸酐趨勢、尿量、藥物、容量與阻塞評估。
stages.evidenceEn: Baseline and creatinine trend, urine, medicines, volume and obstruction assessment.
stages.question: 沒有完整基準值但近期肌酸酐上升；接班應保留哪組資訊？
stages.questionEn: Baseline data are incomplete but creatinine has risen recently. What should handover preserve?

choices.zh: 高值即慢性腎病，門診再查腹瀉新藥
choices.en: Classify chronic disease from this value and defer diarrhoea and new medicines to clinic

choices.zh: 只列最後肌酸酐
choices.en: List the latest creatinine alone

choices.zh: 可查舊值、尿量及藥物時間線
choices.en: Available baselines, urine and medicine timeline

stages.reason: 急慢性判斷需要時間資料，容量與藥物因素也可能參與。
stages.reasonEn: Acute-versus-chronic assessment needs timing; volume and medicines may contribute.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：肌酸酐上升：先找到基準。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Rising creatinine: establish the baseline.

procedures.title: 高血鉀報告：真假與急迫性並行
procedures.titleEn: High potassium: verify while assessing urgency
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：68 歲女性慢性腎病，檢驗室通知血鉀升高。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 68-year-old woman with kidney disease receives a high-potassium alert. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 檢體註記溶血，但她同時心悸。
stages.evidenceEn: The sample is haemolysed but she also has palpitations.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 只等隔週抽血，不評估症狀
choices.en: Wait until next week without symptom assessment

choices.zh: 同步評估心臟風險與檢體
choices.en: Assess cardiac risk while checking the sample

choices.zh: 有溶血就把警訊全部忽略
choices.en: Ignore every warning because haemolysis is noted

stages.reason: 檢體問題不免除症狀評估。
stages.reasonEn: A sample issue does not remove the need to assess symptoms.
stages.pitfall: 單純忽略可能漏掉真正高血鉀。

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 重抽仍偏高，藥單含影響血鉀的藥物。
stages.evidenceEn: Repeat potassium remains high; medicines may contribute.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 只限制所有食物就不需查原因
choices.en: Ban all food instead of reviewing causes

choices.zh: 由遊戲直接指定個人治療劑量
choices.en: Let the game prescribe a personal treatment dose

choices.zh: 由團隊核對藥物及腎功能
choices.en: Review medicines and renal function with the team

stages.reason: 原因與急性風險需同時處理。
stages.reasonEn: Causes and immediate risk both require attention.
stages.pitfall: 未查藥物可能使問題持續。
stages.pitfallEn: Unreviewed medicines may sustain the problem.

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 症狀與心電圖、溶血註記、重抽結果、用藥及後續追蹤。
stages.evidenceEn: Symptoms and ECG, haemolysis, repeat results, medicines and follow-up.
stages.question: 溶血檢體伴心悸，重抽仍血鉀高；哪項最不能在交班省略？
stages.questionEn: A haemolysed sample accompanies palpitations and repeat potassium remains high. What must not be omitted?

choices.zh: 心電圖症狀及確認後的血鉀
choices.en: ECG, symptoms and confirmed potassium

choices.zh: 有溶血即可忽略
choices.en: Haemolysis permits dismissal

choices.zh: 只寫檢體溶血
choices.en: Document haemolysis alone

stages.reason: 檢體限制不能遮蔽持續異常與心臟風險。
stages.reasonEn: A specimen limitation must not obscure persistent abnormality and cardiac risk.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：高血鉀報告：真假與急迫性並行。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of High potassium: verify while assessing urgency.

procedures.title: 血尿加蛋白尿：辨識腎絲球線索
procedures.titleEn: Blood plus protein in urine: glomerular clues
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：32 歲男性茶色尿、眼皮腫與新出現高血壓。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 32-year-old man has tea-coloured urine, eyelid swelling and new hypertension. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 尿液顯微鏡提示變形紅血球與紅血球圓柱。
stages.evidenceEn: Microscopy suggests dysmorphic red cells and red-cell casts.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 所有血尿都只能是泌尿道感染
choices.en: All haematuria must be a urinary infection

choices.zh: 只按尿色判定結石不需檢查
choices.en: Diagnose stones by colour without investigation

choices.zh: 考慮腎絲球來源並評估
choices.en: Consider a glomerular source and investigate

stages.reason: 沉渣與臨床組合能提示來源。
stages.reasonEn: Sediment plus clinical findings can suggest origin.
stages.pitfall: 只貼感染標籤會漏掉腎絲球病。
stages.pitfallEn: An infection label can miss glomerular disease.

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 肌酸酐持續上升，病人又有咳血。
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 緊急整合肺腎共同評估
choices.en: Urgently coordinate pulmonary-renal assessment

choices.zh: 把咳血與腎變化完全分開
choices.en: Treat lung and renal changes as wholly unrelated

choices.zh: 等尿色恢復再決定是否轉介
choices.en: Wait for normal urine colour before referral

stages.reason: 跨器官線索可能提示全身性疾病。
stages.reasonEn: Cross-organ findings may indicate systemic disease.
stages.pitfall: 未整合線索會延誤升級。
stages.pitfallEn: Failure to integrate findings delays escalation.

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 尿沉渣、蛋白與腎功能趨勢、血壓及肺部症狀與專科評估。
stages.evidenceEn: Sediment, protein and kidney trends, pressure, lung symptoms and specialist review.
stages.question: 尿沉渣提示腎絲球來源，腎功能惡化且咳血；專科交班應強調什麼？
stages.questionEn: Sediment suggests glomerular disease with worsening kidneys and haemoptysis. What needs emphasis?

choices.zh: 咳血日後看呼吸科，腎臟只追尿色
choices.en: Leave haemoptysis for a separate later respiratory visit and track urine colour alone for the kidneys

choices.zh: 肺腎跨器官線索與惡化速度
choices.en: Pulmonary-renal clues and the rate of deterioration

choices.zh: 只記尿液顏色
choices.en: Record urine colour alone

stages.reason: 肺與腎的同時異常可能有共同病因，需緊急整合而非割裂。
stages.reasonEn: Concurrent lung and kidney abnormalities may share a cause and need urgent integrated assessment.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：血尿加蛋白尿：辨識腎絲球線索。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Blood plus protein in urine: glomerular clues.

procedures.title: 大量蛋白尿與水腫
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：44 歲女性泡泡尿、腿腫，血白蛋白偏低。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 44-year-old woman has foamy urine, leg oedema and low albumin. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 尿蛋白量明顯增加，腎功能仍接近基準。
stages.evidenceEn: Urine protein rises markedly while renal function stays near baseline.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 評估腎病症候群及病因
choices.en: Assess nephrotic syndrome and its cause

choices.zh: 腎功能近基準就排除重要腎病
choices.en: Near-baseline function excludes important kidney disease

choices.zh: 只把水腫當作站太久
choices.en: Attribute oedema solely to prolonged standing

stages.reason: 蛋白漏失與過濾功能並非相同指標。
stages.reasonEn: Protein loss and filtration are different measures.
stages.pitfall: 只看肌酸酐會漏掉重要蛋白尿。
stages.pitfallEn: Creatinine alone can miss significant protein loss.

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidenceEn: She develops sudden unilateral calf pain and swelling.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 只比較體重不評估單側症狀
choices.en: Compare weight without evaluating asymmetry

choices.zh: 評估血栓等新的併發症
choices.en: Assess thrombosis and new complications

choices.zh: 原本就水腫，所以不用重評
choices.en: Existing oedema makes reassessment unnecessary

stages.reason: 新單側症狀需重新評估。
stages.pitfall: 把新症狀都當舊病會漏掉併發症。
stages.pitfallEn: Attributing everything to baseline may miss complications.

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 蛋白尿、白蛋白與腎功能、病因調查、感染與血栓警訊。
stages.evidenceEn: Proteinuria, albumin and renal function, cause investigation, infection and thrombosis warnings.
stages.question: 蛋白漏失伴低白蛋白，新增單側腿痛腫；交班優先保留哪項？
stages.questionEn: Protein loss and low albumin are joined by new unilateral leg swelling and pain. What has priority?

choices.zh: 單側腫痛視為原水腫，蛋白尿改善再看
choices.en: Attribute new unilateral pain to existing oedema and review the leg after proteinuria improves

choices.zh: 只交班腎功能穩定
choices.en: Hand over stable renal filtration alone

choices.zh: 新單側症狀與血栓評估需求
choices.en: New unilateral findings and thrombosis assessment

stages.reason: 新的局部症狀不能用既有水腫解釋，需要重評併發症。
stages.reasonEn: New local symptoms cannot simply be explained by existing oedema; complications need reassessment.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：大量蛋白尿與水腫。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Heavy proteinuria and oedema.

procedures.title: 慢性腎病分層：不只一個 eGFR
procedures.titleEn: CKD risk: more than one eGFR
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：62 歲女性糖尿病追蹤，eGFR 下降與尿白蛋白增加。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 62-year-old woman with diabetes has reduced eGFR and increased urine albumin. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 透析通路異常：辨識而非盲目操作
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲男性透析前發現通路外觀和平日不同。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 58-year-old man notices a change in his access before dialysis. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 低血鈉與混亂：查原因也看症狀
procedures.titleEn: Low sodium and confusion: cause plus symptoms
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：77 歲女性新使用利尿劑後食慾差、走路不穩。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 77-year-old woman has poor intake and unsteady gait after a new diuretic. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 無尿不只腎實質：別漏掉阻塞
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：80 歲男性排尿逐漸困難，今天幾乎無尿。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: An 80-year-old man has progressive voiding difficulty and almost no urine today. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 運動後深色尿：試紙與顯微鏡不一致
procedures.titleEn: Dark urine after exercise: dipstick and microscopy disagree
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：29 歲患者不習慣的劇烈運動後肌肉劇痛、無力與深色尿。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 29-year-old develops severe muscle pain, weakness and dark urine after unfamiliar intense exercise.

procedures.title: 血尿合併咳血：跨器官線索
procedures.titleEn: Haematuria and haemoptysis: a multisystem clue
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：46 歲患者血尿、腎功能快速改變，近兩天又咳血與喘。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 46-year-old has haematuria, rapidly changing kidney function and new haemoptysis and dyspnoea.

procedures.title: 移植後肌酸酐上升：先別只貼上排斥標籤
procedures.titleEn: Rising creatinine after transplantation: not automatically rejection
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：腎移植患者回診時肌酸酐較基準上升，最近有腹瀉與新處方。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A kidney transplant recipient has creatinine above baseline after diarrhoea and a new prescription.

procedures.title: 慢性腎病中的骨痛與礦物代謝
procedures.titleEn: Bone symptoms and mineral metabolism in chronic kidney disease
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：長期慢性腎病患者有骨痛，檢驗顯示鈣、磷與副甲狀腺素變化。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A patient with chronic kidney disease has bone pain and changing calcium, phosphate and parathyroid hormone results.

procedures.title: 血液透析原理與處方
procedures.patient: 依課程「血液透析原理與處方」設定的虛擬情境：透析膜、Kt/V、乾體重與透析中低血壓。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Haemodialysis principles and prescription": Membranes, Kt/V, dry weight and intradialytic hypotension. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 3：乾體重與透析…

procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Changes in kidney graft function": Compare rejection infection and obstruction; Review immunosuppression and interactions; Integrate baseline and serial tests The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
